propositions: Ticket-type mapping dict _LOCAL_TO_JIRA_TYPE is duplicated across Cloud create path (outbound_fields.py:88) and DC create path (backend.py:43), creating risk of silent divergence like fe15's status map drift.
The duplication is not guarded by existing one-literal assertions that protect status and priority maps, allowing a third copy to be introduced undetected.
Both existing copies are content-identical (same four keys and values, differing only in literal key order), so unification is behaviour-preserving and requires no divergence decision.

Single definition must move to adapters/jira_family/value_maps.py following the J2 precedent, with both create paths importing under the historical alias _LOCAL_TO_JIRA_TYPE to preserve module-attribute resolution.
Boundary guard test must extend to ticket-type map with mutation-verification that re-introducing a second literal fails the build with clear error message.
Create-path characterization must pin the type mapping by value for all four local types (task/story/bug/epic) on both Cloud and DC paths.
